description: Direct browser MIDI and serial, reviewed stock updates, graphical firmware modules and Codex project builds.

interface.defaultPrompt: Open FM-1 Forge and connect FM-1 directly in the native panel.
interface.longDescription: Connect FM-1 using browser MIDI or USB serial without a local bridge process. Review the exact official stock package before a SysEx update, configure firmware modules graphically, and ask Codex to build. Keep local firmware bytes in the browser and preserve durable recovery evidence. Existing UBOOT mass-storage recovery remains manual.
